name: frontend-interaction-design-plugin
description: Turns PRDs, durable prototype evidence, and API contracts into a Feishu-first review package with rendered diagrams, precise block-linked navigation, and a revision-pinned local frontend design snapshot without generating code.

interface.longDescription: Confirm the target frontend project and feature version, persist PRD, prototype, and API evidence outside the chat, clarify consequential ambiguity, generate traceable interaction models, publish rendered diagrams with precise evidence and diagram block navigation in a self-explanatory Feishu review document, and export a revision-pinned local engineering snapshot. The plugin never generates or modifies application code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD, prototype, and API contract into a Feishu-first frontend design package.
Persist these prototype images in Feishu, clarify gaps, and generate a reviewable frontend plan.
Capture this Figma scope, publish the plan to Feishu, and export the confirmed revision locally.
